mod.name: Purr!
mod.description: Talk to the other players through Steam voice: a voice comes from the player's cat and fades with distance, with push to talk or an open microphone.

setting.Voice.Enabled.description: Voice chat with the players who have this mod too. Off, you neither talk nor hear anyone.
setting.Voice.Volume.description: How loud the other players are: 1 is as Steam gives them, 2 is twice as loud.
setting.Microphone.Mode.description: Push to talk sends your voice only while you hold the key below. Open microphone sends it whenever Steam hears you. The microphone itself is the one chosen in Steam: Settings, Voice.
setting.Microphone.PushToTalkKey.description: Hold it to talk in push to talk mode.
setting.Microphone.Muted.description: Turns your microphone off: nobody hears you, you still hear everyone.
setting.Microphone.MuteKey.description: Turns the microphone off or on.
setting.Headphones.Deafened.description: Turns the other players off: you hear nobody, and your microphone is off too until you turn them back on.
setting.Headphones.DeafenKey.description: Turns the other players off or on.
setting.Sound.Sound.description: In space, a voice comes from the player's cat and gets quieter with distance. Flat, everyone sounds the same wherever they are. In the lobby voices are always flat.
setting.Sound.HearDistance.description: In space, how far away a voice is still heard, in metres.
setting.Sound.FullVolumeDistance.description: In space, up to this distance a voice is at full volume, in metres.
setting.Screen.ShowSpeakers.description: Lists who is talking right now in a corner of the screen during a level.
setting.Screen.Corner.description: The corner of the screen for the list of who is talking.
setting.Screen.NameTags.description: Colours the name over a cat while that player is talking.
setting.Screen.Notices.description: Says on the screen when the microphone or the headphones are turned off or on with the keys.
